[[Platinum Stars F.C.|Silver Stars]] (Inland) | promoted = [[AmaZulu F.C.|AmaZulu]], [[Platinum Stars F.C.|Silver Stars]] | relegated = | matches = | total goals = | prevseason = [[2001–02 National First Division|2001–02]] | nextseason = [[2003–04 National First Division|2003–04]] }} The '''2002–03 National First Division''' was the 7th season of [[National First Division|the second tier]] of South African [[Association football|soccer]] since the reorganisation in 1996. It consisted of two streams, an Inland stream of 16 teams, and a Coastal stream of 14 teams. The Coastal stream was won by [[AmaZulu F.C.|AmaZulu]] and the Inland stream by [[Platinum Stars F.C.|Silver Stars]], with both earning promotion to the [[2003–04 Premier Soccer League]].{{Cite web |title=History |url=https://mail.highlandspark.co.za/index.php/ct-menu-item-3/ct-menu-item-5 |access-date=2023-08-11 |website=mail.highlandspark.co.za}}{{Cite web |date=1 Feb 2019 |title=PSL clubs since 1994 |url=https://www.pressreader.com/south-africa/kick-off/20190201/281599536706176 |access-date=2023-08-11 |website=Kick Off |via=PressReader}}{{Cite web |title=About the NFD |url=https://psl.co.za/content/16306 |access-date=2023-08-11 |website=psl.co.za}} ==Coastal stream== ===League table=== {{#invoke:Sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=PQR |update=complete |source={{Cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesz/zaf03.html|title=South Africa 2002/03}} |team1=LOU |name_LOU = [[AmaZulu F.C.|AmaZulu]] |team2=CIT |name_CIT = [[Premier United F.C.|Premier United]] |team3=AVE |name_AVE = [[Avendale Athletico]] |team4=FC |name_FC = [[FC Fortune]] |team5=TIG |name_TIG = Basotho Tigers |team6=BEN |name_BEN = [[Park United F.C.|Park United]] |team7=ZUL |name_ZUL = [[Maritzburg City F.C.|Maritzburg City]] |team8=WIT |name_WIT = [[Rainbow Stars F.C.|Rainbow Stars]] |team9=PJ |name_PJ = [[Uthukela]] |team10=DUR |name_DUR = [[Royal Tigers F.C.|Royal Tigers]] |team11=VAS |name_VAS = [[Moja United F.C.|Moja United]] |team12=MAR |name_MAR = [[Juventus F.C.
